items.title: 68252_Jay Cee
items.q: Some of J. C.'s songs were recorded by the following people: Red Allen, Count Basie, Connie Boswell, Billy Butterfield, Bing Crosby, Duke Ellington, Ella Fitzgerald, Al Hibbler, Earl Hines

ctx.x: Well, as he said, rents skyrocketed and the idea came to borrow church suppers and raise money to pay the rent.

Some of J. C.'s songs were recorded by the following people: Red Allen, Count Basie, Connie Boswell, Billy Butterfield, Bing Crosby, Duke Ellington, Ella Fitzgerald, Al Hibbler, Earl Hines, Billie Holiday, Claude Hopkins, James P. Johnson,

Pete Kelly, Dean Kincaid, Freddie Martin, Don Redmond, Della Reese, Bessie Smith -- we're going alphabetically, as you can see -- Fats Waller, Kaye Stark, Dinah Washington, Ethel Waters, Josh White, Paul Young, Paul Whiteman, Lester Young and others.
